serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Certivo is an AI-powered product and supply chain compliance platform for manufacturers and regulated industries. It replaces manual, spreadsheet-driven compliance work with a continuously maintained evidence base that links every supplier document to the parts, products, and requirements it supports.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Public Trust Center containing security, compliance, and authorization information for the Certivo Compliance Platform.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Certivo Secure Configuration Guide (version 1.1.1, effective 8 October 2026) for the Certivo Compliance Platform. Open the Resources page of the Certivo Trust Center at https://trust-gov.certivo.com/resources and select View or download on Certivo Secure Configuration Guide.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: FedRAMP Certification Data for package FR2631258125 in the Trust Center Resources section: Security Decision Record (JSON and human-readable), Ongoing Certification Report, Ongoing Certification Report and Incident Report schemas, SOC 2 Type II report with bridge letter, Class A Assessment Evidence Register, Amazon Inspector and AWS Config exports for the AWS GovCloud (US) account, and the FedRAMP Access Control, Personnel Security, System and Information Integrity, and Awareness and Training Policies and the Incident Response Policy, Plan and Procedure (v1.1). The other FedRAMP policies and procedures (v1.1) that the Security Decision Record cites are approved in Vanta Gov and available to FedRAMP on request.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Open the Trust Center at https://trust-gov.certivo.com/ and select Request access. Agencies and FedRAMP are given access to requestable documents after Certivo verifies the requester. Questions: security@certivo.com.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The whole cloud service offering, delivered as SaaS from AWS GovCloud (US) us-gov-west-1: the web application and API, rule evaluation, AI-assisted (LLM) processing on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US), framework orchestration, batch operations and scheduled jobs. All features of the Certivo Compliance Platform are in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope; no feature is excluded. LLM jobs call no model or service outside AWS GovCloud (US); all model calls go to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). Security category (FIPS 199): Moderate.
